ui.heroSupport: Understand how sales, labor, costs and demand move together. Cross-Intelligence connects the operating areas covered by your Core package.

components.headline: Compare campaign timing with sales.
components.description: Review how sales and demand change around a campaign. Compare the timing, attribution window and other operating changes before drawing a conclusion.

components.title: Possible explanations
components.headline: Investigate what may explain a metric change.
components.description: Explore related movements in sales, labor and costs. Check the supporting records and other changes before deciding what caused the result.

components.headline: Compare spend and operating performance.
components.description: Put available marketing, labor and other cost measures beside revenue and contribution. Check allocation and attribution assumptions when discussing the return.
Investigate whether a new item, offer or campaign coincides with changes in existing sales. Check mix, demand and the comparison period before treating it as cannibalization.

components.headline: See what changed alongside the metric.
components.description: Review related changes across connected sources to identify possible explanations. A correlation supports investigation; it does not establish causation.

howSteps.description: Generate forecasts with confidence ranges from the operating data and configured assumptions. Review the available horizons and any market signals used.
Compare forecast with actual, review systematic bias and update the assumptions or model. Accuracy depends on data coverage and operating conditions.

foresight.componentsDescription: Compare forecast timelines, scenarios, scheduling and purchasing assumptions, and executive planning views.

components.description: Use the executive briefing to review forecast risks, opportunities and proposed actions. Confirm delivery settings for your operation.

intelligence.heroTitle: Ask an operating question. Explore the answer.
intelligence.responseDescription: Explore answers through the supported data cards, charts and analysis views.
intelligence.briefingDescription: Use a personalized briefing to start the operating review.

differentiators.description: Ask a question in plain language and explore the answer with the supporting operating data.

differentiators.title: Connect the records behind the question
differentiators.description: Use connected POS, workforce, inventory, reservation and delivery records according to your setup and access permissions.

watchtower.heroTitle: Understand the market around each location.
watchtower.introDescription: Review relevant competitor, event, weather and market signals beside the operation. Use the context to investigate a change or plan the next response.

features.description: Bring relevant competitor activity, local events and weather beside your own operating data in a prioritized briefing. Review the sources and relevance before acting.

faqs.a: Watchtower brings relevant external signals and operating context into a prioritized briefing. Review available delivery settings, market coverage and refresh timing with Sundae.

blocks.description: Use sales history, seasonality and configured calendar events to set location targets. Review unusual periods and the assumptions behind the plan.

targets.heading: Review the target and its assumptions.
targets.description: Use sales history, patterns and relevant calendar events to plan targets. Mark unusual or recurring events and compare actual performance with the plan.

server.description: Compare available sales and workload measures by shift, hour or service phase. Use the context of role, coverage and service conditions when coaching the team.

cost.description: Compare staffing, hours and available cost records with shift revenue. Check rates, allocated costs and unresolved entries before using the comparison to change coverage.

insights.ctaDescription: Choose the Core coverage your operating questions need, then review the relevant sources and capabilities in a walkthrough.
